title: 第322章 破防第321章 捷报传来
slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了
content_zh:
当然，作为靠说书吃饭的他，已经有明显的感觉，那就是高手变多了。
要知道在过往的很长时间以来，融丹期都是玄国天榜前三的存在。
但现在好像是修炼和突破都变容易了，最近江湖上传闻突破融丹期的已不在少数。
他沉默了片刻，忽然问了一句：“杜西来呢？杜西来逃了没有？”
“逃了。”年轻人点了点头。
“被凡净大师打伤了左肩，逃回了燕国。
但他带去的那些蕴丹期高手，一个都没跑掉，全被咱们的高手围杀了。”
他说着，又从怀中掏出一张皱巴巴的纸笺，那是他从北边驿站抄来的快报，上面密密麻麻写满了字：
“这是镇武司抄送各州的战报，上面写得清清楚楚。
真如寺真玄大师，融丹初期，雁门关外连斩融丹初期两人，协助凡净大师击退杜西来，功居第一。”
......
九月十二，真如寺。
山门前的石阶被秋日的阳光晒得微微发烫，青石缝里长出的几株狗尾巴草在风中摇曳。
两旁的松柏一如既往地沉默着，但在枝叶间隐约系了几条红绸，在暮色中猎猎飘动，像一团团燃烧的火。
这是知客堂的弟子们连夜挂上去的，说是有“喜庆”的意思。
真如寺在云州澜沧府这个地头上，称得上是保一方平安的名门大派。
寺内高僧在和敌国高手“决战雁门关”时露了大脸，所有香客们都是与有荣焉。
山门内侧的青石甬道上，香客们来来往往，比平日里多了不知道多少倍。
有挑着担子的，有牵着孩子的，有拄着拐杖的，还有坐着马车从外地专程赶来的。
山上弥漫着檀香的味道。

“让一让，让一让——”一个十七八岁的年轻香客举着一面“有求必应”的锦旗，在人群中挤来挤去。
他穿着一件洗得发白的月白色长衫，腰间系着一条青布带，脚下一双黑布鞋，帽檐上还插着一朵不知从哪里摘来的野菊花。
满脸涨得通红，额头上青筋暴起，显然是费了九牛二虎之力才从人群中挤到甬道上来。
“大师傅，请问真玄大师的禅房在哪里？”他气喘吁吁地问一个正在维持秩序的知客僧。
那知客僧是“破”字辈的弟子，看起来十七八岁的年纪，面容青涩，眉宇间却带着一种与年龄不符的沉稳。
他双手合十，行了一礼，语气客气而疏离：
“施主，真玄师叔祖的禅房在破妄禅院，不对外开放。
施主若想上香祈福，可去真如宝殿。”
年轻香客急了，手里的锦旗一抖，上面的字在日光下格外醒目：
“真玄大师慈悲为怀，一刀斩妖，护国佑民”。
旁边还歪歪扭扭写了一行小字：“信男周大壮敬献”。
“我不是上香！我是来谢恩的！”他把锦旗又举高了几分，“我爹去年在光雾山深处遇到一个猿妖，幸亏真玄大师路过，一掌就把那妖修拍死了！”
旁边一个头发花白的老太太拄着拐杖，颤巍巍地挤了过来。
她穿着一件靛蓝色的粗布褂子，头上包着一块同样颜色的头巾，脸上满是皱纹。
听了年轻人的话，她连连点头：
content_en:
Of course, as someone who relies on storytelling for a living, he already has a clear feeling that there are more masters.
You must know that for a long time in the past, the Merging Pill Stage has been among the top three in the Xuan Kingdom's Heavenly Ranking.
But now it seems that cultivation and breakthroughs have become easier. Recently, there are many rumors in the world about people who have broken through the core-melting stage.
He was silent for a moment and suddenly asked: "Where is Du Xi Lai? Has Du Xi Lai escaped?"
"Escaped." The young man nodded.
"My left shoulder was injured by Master Fanjing and I fled back to Yan State.
But none of the Yundan stage masters he brought with him ran away, they were all surrounded and killed by our masters. "
As he spoke, he took out a crumpled piece of paper from his arms. It was the dispatch he copied from the northern post station. It was densely written with words:
"This is the battle report sent by the Zhenwu Division to all states, and it is clearly written on it.
Master Zhenxuan of Zhenru Temple, in the early stage of Dan-Rong, killed two people outside Yanmen Pass in the early stage of Dan-Rong. He assisted Master Fanjing to repel Du Xilai, ranking first in merit. "
...
September 12th, Zhenru Temple.
The stone steps in front of the mountain gate were slightly heated by the autumn sun, and several foxtail grass growing out of the cracks in the bluestones swayed in the wind.
The pines and cypresses on both sides were as silent as ever, but a few strips of red silk were vaguely tied between the branches and leaves, fluttering in the dusk like balls of burning fire.
The disciples of Zhi Ke Hall hung it up overnight, saying it had a "happy" meaning.
Zhenru Temple is located in Lancang Prefecture, Yunzhou, and can be regarded as a famous sect that ensures peace.
The eminent monk in the temple showed his face during the "decisive battle at Yanmen Pass" with the enemy's masters, and all the pilgrims were honored.
On the bluestone corridor inside the mountain gate, pilgrims came and went, many times more than usual.
Some were carrying burdens, some were holding children, some were using crutches, and some were coming from other places in carriages.
The mountain is filled with the smell of sandalwood.
"Give way, give way--" A young pilgrim, about 17 or 18 years old, held up a banner that read "All requests are granted" and squeezed through the crowd.
He was wearing a moon-white gown that had been washed white, with a green cloth belt tied around his waist, a pair of black cloth shoes at his feet, and a wild chrysanthemum picked from nowhere on the brim of his hat.
His face was flushed red and veins popped out on his forehead. It was obvious that he had spent a lot of effort to squeeze through the crowd and onto the corridor.
"Master, where is Master Zhenxuan's meditation room?" he asked breathlessly to a Zhike monk who was maintaining order.
Unexpectedly, the guest monk was a disciple of the "Po" generation. He looked about seventeen or eighteen years old, with a green face, but a calmness in his eyebrows that was inconsistent with his age.
He clasped his hands together and saluted, his tone polite and distant:
“Donor, Master Zhenxuan’s uncle’s Zen room is in Powang Zen Temple and is not open to the public.
If the donor wants to offer incense and pray for blessings, he can go to Zhenru Palace. "
The young pilgrim became anxious and flicked the banner in his hand. The words on it were particularly eye-catching in the sunlight:
"Master Zhenxuan is compassionate, kills monsters with one sword, and protects the country and the people."
There is also a line of small characters written crookedly next to it: "Dedicated to the letter man Zhou Dazhuang."
"I'm not offering incense! I'm here to thank you!" He raised the banner a little higher, "My father encountered an ape demon deep in Guangwu Mountain last year. Fortunately, Master Zhenxuan passed by and slapped the demon cultivator to death with one palm!"
Next to me, a gray-haired old lady leaned on a cane and squeezed over tremblingly.
She was wearing an indigo coarse cloth gown, a scarf of the same color on her head, and her face was full of wrinkles.
After listening to the young man's words, she nodded repeatedly:
